messages:
alex: Hey, hitting a weird one in the sample app during onboarding. After a cold start + network switch (wifi->cell) we sometimes see duplicate POSTs for the same request and intermittent 401s. Repro is small but consistent on Pixel 7A, Android 13 and 15.

alex: Steps: open app, sign in, quickly toggle wifi off -> mobile on. Happens while token refresh is in-flight.

alex: Minimal interceptor we use: 
```
class AuthInterceptor: Interceptor {
  override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
    val token = TokenProvider.getSyncToken() // blocks to refresh if needed
    val req = chain.request().newBuilder().addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer $token").build()
    return chain.proceed(req)
  }
}
```

alex: Logs show two enqueues for the same request id, one gets 401 then token refresh, other proceeds with stale token -> 401 -> retry -> duplicate side-effects on server. Sometimes we see okhttp quietly resubmit after dispatcher thread wakeup. Attaching small log snippet: 
```
I/OkHttp: --> POST /api/submit id=42
I/OkHttp: <-- 401 /api/submit id=42
I/TokenRefresher: refresh start
I/OkHttp: --> POST /api/submit id=42 <- duplicate
I/TokenRefresher: refresh done
I/OkHttp: --> POST /api/submit id=43 (retry)
```

maria: Do we have any custom CallAdapter or coroutine adapter wrapping that could re-enqueue on resume? Also check if callTimeout vs readTimeout interplay is canceling and creating new calls.

alex: We're using Retrofit's built-in suspend adapter + a small wrapper to convert to Result. No custom enqueue logic. Call timeout isn't set explicitly (default). Observed behavior seems timing related to connectivity change broadcasts.

kendall: Could be ProGuard/R8 removing the equals/hashCode from a request tag or something that OkHttp uses to dedupe? Unlikely but saw weirdness when we obfuscated request identifiers. Are we bundling the sampleapp with minifyEnabled=true in the debug build?

alex: Oh — we do have minify enabled on the sample app in our debug build (leftover). Will disable and retest. Nice catch.

sam: Also check that TokenProvider.getSyncToken() doesn't re-create the OkHttp client or call execute() on same request object twice. Shared OkHttpClient + new Request each time is required.

alex: Confirmed: disabling minify made the dupes go away in my quick runs. With minify=true I see duplicate POSTs ~60% of runs. With minify=false it's near 0%.

maria: That points to R8 removing some synthetic bridge or preserving behavior that affects interceptor ordering? Could be an optimization inlining a synchronized helper that changes timing. File a small repro with both builds. Might need proguard keep rules to preserve interceptor class/method names or token provider methods.

kendall: Suggest adding explicit keep rules: `-keep class com.redwood.sample.auth.** { *; }` and `-keepclassmembers class okhttp3.** { *; }` (tighten later). But let's confirm minimal rule. Also add a test on the sampleapp CI to run the connectivity toggle flow.

ci-bot: CI note: sampleapp/debug-minified build is currently on the nightly matrix. Adding a flaky e2e that toggles connectivity will increase runtime; maybe add as optional check first.

alex: For immediate fix I'm going to turn off minify on debug builds and add a comment in the sample README. Will open an issue with repro steps and attach two APKs+logs.

sam: Long-term we should: 1) ensure TokenProvider doesn't block on main thread, 2) switch to atomic single-source-of-truth token refresh (dedupe refreshes), 3) add proguard keep rules for token/provider classes used by interceptors.

alex: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/issues/78 and pushed logs. Thanks all :raised_hands:

runtime-bot: FYI — runtime alert: we recently rolled out a tiny okhttp update that changed dispatcher wake semantics on Android. Might be related; tagging eng-runtime for awareness.

kendall: Thanks @runtime-bot — eng-runtime, can you confirm if the okhttp bump could interact with R8-optimized bytecode on certain devices? :eyes:

eng-runtime: We saw one change in wake ordering but couldn't reproduce duplicate enqueues in our harness. Happy to pair on the repro.

alex: Will schedule a pairing session with eng-runtime. Leaving minify disabled on debug until we ship a guard.
